item.title: Asian Cultures Around Campus: Mahjong Mondays — Mon Sep 14, 4:00 PM — Asian Culture Center (807 E 10th street
item.description:
Once associated with older generations, Mahjong has now found a new home among the young. Social clubs have emerged dedicated to playing Mahjong to reconnect with culture and, more importantly, to foster new friendships. At the ACC, we offer a casual and informal Mahjong experience, perfect for those looking to learn the game, take a break from the digital world, and most importantly, meet new friends in person. You do not need to be an expert to join us, just bring your enthusiasm and a willingness to learn! All Indiana University events, groups, activities, and educational, cultural, and historical observances welcome all IU students and other members of the Indiana University community.For more information, view this event in BeInvolved (https://beinvolved.indiana.edu/event/12470842).
Source: IU Asian Culture Center

item.title: It's On Us: Bystander Intervention Workshop — Tue Sep 15, 6:00 PM — Global & International Studies Building
item.description:
The It’s On Us: Bystander Intervention Workshop is a 90-minute, audience-driven bystander intervention program that teaches students the skills needed to help in situations involving alcohol and drug use that could lead to a sexual assault. Students practice helping in real-life scenarios and discuss how alcohol and drug use influences a person’s ability to give and get consent to engage in sexual activity with another person.
It's On Us is required for all first-year and transfer undergraduate students. You must attend one session to fulfill the requirement.
Instructions:
Those who arrive more than 5 minutes after the start time will NOT be allowed into the session and will need to attend a different session
If this is your assigned workshop but you cannot attend it in its entirety, please RSVP for a different workshop.
If you have concerns about attending due to personal experiences or need to request accommodations, please contact the office at itsonus@iu.edu.
A

item.description:

That's why we are proud to partner with Counseling & Psychological Services (CAPS) to provide an embedded counselor in our space every Monday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mollibeth Penner, LHMCA serves as our embedded counselor and works directly with students connected to the LGBTQ+ Culture Center. To schedule an appointment, please call CAPS (https://healthcenter.indiana.edu/make-appointment/index.html) and let them know you are an LGBTQ+ Culture Center student interested in meeting with Mollibeth at the center. We hope this partnership makes it easier for you to access support in a space where you feel comfortable and affirmed. All Indiana University events, groups, activities, educational, cultural, and historical observances welcome all members of the Indiana University community.

item.title: Union Board Global Connections present: Culture through the Senses — Tue Oct 6, 6:00 PM — Frangipani Room
item.description:
Immerse yourself in the vibrant traditions and rich diversity of the Latine community at Culture Through the Senses. Whether you are looking to honor your roots or experience something new, join us in the Alumni Hall & Solarium for an unforgettable journey through sound, sight, touch, and taste:
Sight: Marvel at captivating dance performances and browse an inspiring art showcase featuring talented local Latine artists.
Sound: Feel the rhythm of the culture with a curated backdrop of traditional and modern music.
Touch: Get hands-on and create your own cultural keepsakes with fun interactive crafts.
Taste: Treat your palate to a live cooking demonstration by an IMU chef featuring iconic flavors.
Bring your friends, bring your appetite, and bring your curiosity to this campus-wide celebration. All Indiana University events, groups, activities, and educational, cultural, and historical observances welcome all IU students and other members of the Indiana University community.
